title: Rubber Duck Sovereign
description: A surreal black and white ink illustration features a giant glowing purple rubber duck wearing a flaming crown, floating within a magical purple circle in the sky. Below, a skeleton king with a crown and scepter holds a small mirror reflecting the same duck and a tiny traveler, while a child with a backpack walks along a path through a spooky forest of skull-faced trees toward crystal formations, with a red ringed planet in the background.
prompt: Surreal black and white fantasy illustration with selective purple and red coloring. A giant glowing purple rubber duck with white dots and skull patterns, wearing a fiery crown, floats inside a purple magical circle in the sky. In the foreground, a crowned skeleton king holds a scepter and a small round mirror reflecting the duck and a traveler. A child with a backpack walks a stone path through a dark forest of trees with screaming skull faces, past crystals and flowers, with a red ringed planet in the background, intricate linework, detailed ink style.
